title: 2023 AMC 12B Problem 4
statement: Jackson’s paintbrush makes a narrow strip with a width of \(6.5\) millimeters. Jackson has enough paint to make a strip \(25\) meters long. How many square centimeters of paper could Jackson cover with paint?

solutions.text:
Converting units, the strip is \(0.65\) cm wide and \(2500\) cm long, so its area is \(0.65\times 2500=1625\) square centimeters.

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: Convert every length to centimeters before multiplying
The width is \(6.5\text{ mm}=0.65\text{ cm}\) and the length is \(25\text{ m}=2500\text{ cm}\)
